title: Why Solid Things Are Almost Empty

scenes.text: Look at this table. It feels solid.
It is almost entirely empty space.
Every atom is a nucleus, wrapped in electrons.
The nucleus is a hundred thousand times smaller.
If the nucleus were a marble, the atom would be a kilometre wide.
So an atom is more than ninety nine point nine percent empty.
Almost all of its mass sits in that tiny core.
The rest is fields, not stuff.
Solid is a feeling, not a fact.
